prompt: A school orders $24$ boxes of pencils with $36$ pencils in each box. The office keeps $150$ pencils. How many pencils are left for the classrooms?
hint: Two steps: first find the total pencils, then take away what the office keeps.

hints.text: Two steps: first find the total pencils, then take away what the office keeps.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: If there were $2$ boxes of $36$, that would be $72$ pencils. Now scale the same idea up to $24$ boxes.

explanation: So $714$ pencils go to the classrooms.

alternativeExplanations.title: Estimate first
steps: $900 - 150 = 750$, so an answer near $714$ makes sense.
